title: Autopsy of Future Emotions
narrativeSpine: An inquiry into how AI changes emotional coordination; evidence levels distinguish plausible adaptation from speculative new feelings.
firstSceneDraft: Autopsy of Future Emotions asks what achievement means when competent output becomes cheap.
The book follows how changing contribution, recognition, and status may reshape emotional life.
This nonfiction inquiry separates research findings from interpretation and speculative possibilities.
That distinction makes its future scenarios useful without presenting them as forecasts.
visualActionProposal: A workplace desk shifts from earned output to supervised output; the same person’s contribution remains while its visibility changes.
